spec.description: Application Performance Index (Apdex, https://www.apdex.org/) score and latency metrics for Tuist web page loads. Panels read production server logs from Tuist Pulse SQL (opentelemetry_logs). Page-load panels use the request_kind="page_load" Request completed lines (status, duration_ms), excluding the /ready kubelet probe. Marketing static asset panels use request_kind="marketing_static_asset" timing logs emitted before Plug.Static serves /marketing/assets and /marketing/images. T=1s (satisfied <1s, tolerating 1-4s, frustrated >4s).

spec.title: Apdex Score (T=1s)
spec.description: Proper Apdex formula: (Satisfied + Tolerating÷2) / Total. T=1s: Satisfied ≤1s, Tolerating 1–4s, Frustrated >4s. Score 0.94+ = Excellent, 0.7+ = Poor, <0.7 = Unacceptable.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT (sum(CASE WHEN ms <= 1000 THEN 1.0 WHEN ms <= 4000 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END) / count(*)) AS "Apdex (T=1s)"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r
WHERE ms IS NOT NULL

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Total page load requests per second across all web UI routes.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) / ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) AS "Page Loads/s"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r

spec.title: P99 Latency (ms)
spec.description: 99th percentile page load response time across all web UI routes.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P99"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r
WHERE ms IS NOT NULL

spec.title: Error Rate (5xx)
spec.description: Rate of HTTP 5xx errors on web UI page load routes.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN status >= 500 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) / ($__unixEpochTo() - $__unixEpochFrom()) AS "5xx/s"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r

spec.title: Apdex Score Over Time
spec.description: Proper Apdex (Satisfied + Tolerating÷2) / Total. Two thresholds: T=1s (your current standard) and T=200ms (industry standard for interactive web apps). Green zone ≥0.94 (Excellent), yellow ≥0.7 (Poor), red <0.7 (Unacceptable).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  (sum(CASE WHEN ms <= 1000 THEN 1.0 WHEN ms <= 4000 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END) / count(*)) AS "Apdex T=1s",
  (sum(CASE WHEN ms <= 200 THEN 1.0 WHEN ms <= 800 THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.0 END) / count(*)) AS "Apdex T=200ms"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r
WHERE ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Request Rate
spec.description: Request throughput per web page route. Useful for correlating latency spikes with traffic volume changes.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "Page Loads/s"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Latency Percentiles (P50 / P95 / P99)
spec.description: P50 and P95 response time trends for all web UI page load routes. Use this to catch latency regressions before Apdex breaches threshold.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P95",
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P99"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' duration_ms=([0-9.]+)')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, ' status=([0-9]+)')[1] AS BIGINT) AS status
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=page_load%'
    AND body LIKE '%Request completed%'
    AND body NOT LIKE '% request_path=/ready %') r
WHERE ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Static Origin Request Rate
spec.description: Marketing static asset responses served by the Tuist origin per second. After versioned assets are cached at Cloudflare edge locations, this should trend down because repeat requests stop reaching the server.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) / ($__interval_ms / 1000.0) AS "Origin asset responses/s"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, 'Sent [0-9]+ in ([0-9]+)ms')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=marketing_static_asset%'
    AND body LIKE '%Sent % in %ms%') r
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

spec.title: Static Origin Latency Percentiles (P50 / P95 / P99)
spec.description: Response time percentiles for marketing static assets that still reach the Tuist origin. Lower traffic and latency here indicate that Cloudflare edge caching is absorbing repeat asset requests.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(timestamp, $__interval),
  percentile_cont(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P50",
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P95",
  percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ms) AS "P99"
FROM (SELECT timestamp,
    CAST(regexp_match(body, 'Sent [0-9]+ in ([0-9]+)ms')[1] AS DOUBLE) AS ms
  FROM opentelemetry_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'cluster') = 'tuist-production'
    AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, 'container') = 'server'
    AND body LIKE '%request_kind=marketing_static_asset%'
    AND body LIKE '%Sent % in %ms%') r
WHERE ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
